name: Implicit Geometric Locus
description: Transforms algebraic inequalities into topological properties of Cartesian products of intervals in 2D space. Separation becomes half-plane inclusion for the polytope; dispersion becomes disjointness of 1D projections; boundaries become bounding-box inclusion. This defeats survivors by completely removing the explicit algebraic sums and inequalities from the text, forcing them to derive the $q_1+q_2 > T$ and $\sum q > T$ impossibility bounds purely from geometric packing logic.
